name: Line topology
description: Each line's stations and the machine type at each, as a graph.
gql:
MATCH (l:equipment_ProductionLine)<-[e1:equipment_equipment_StationOnLine]-(s:equipment_Station)-[e2:equipment_equipment_StationRunsMachineType]->(m:equipment_MachineType)
RETURN l, e1, s, e2, m
LIMIT 100

name: Part genealogy (latest Line-C parts)
description: The stations the most recent Line-C parts passed through, in flow order.
gql:
MATCH (p:production_Part)-[:production_production_PartProcessedAtStation]->(s:equipment_Station)
WHERE p.line_id = 'Line-C'
RETURN p.part_id AS part, p.started_at AS started_at, s.station_position AS position, s.machine_type AS station
ORDER BY started_at DESC, position ASC
LIMIT 30

name: Fault blast radius (mechanical wear)
description: Stations with mechanical-wear work orders and how many parts passed through them.
gql:
MATCH (i:maintenance_IssueType)<-[:maintenance_maintenance_WorkOrderClassifiedAs]-(w:maintenance_WorkOrder)-[:maintenance_maintenance_WorkOrderOnStation]->(s:equipment_Station)<-[:production_production_PartProcessedAtStation]-(p:production_Part)
WHERE i.category = 'Mechanical-Wear'
RETURN s.device_id AS station, s.machine_type AS machine, count(DISTINCT w) AS work_orders, count(DISTINCT p) AS parts_processed
GROUP BY station, machine
ORDER BY work_orders DESC
LIMIT 10

name: Repeat-fault stations and their SOPs
description: Stations ranked by work orders, with the SOPs a technician should open.
gql:
MATCH (w:maintenance_WorkOrder)-[:maintenance_maintenance_WorkOrderOnStation]->(s:equipment_Station)<-[:knowledge_knowledge_SopForStation]-(d:knowledge_SOP)
RETURN s.device_id AS station, s.machine_type AS machine, d.title AS sop, d.file_name AS document, count(w) AS work_orders
GROUP BY station, machine, sop, document
ORDER BY work_orders DESC
LIMIT 10

name: Technician coverage by line
description: Work orders per technician and line.
gql:
MATCH (t:maintenance_Technician)<-[:maintenance_maintenance_WorkOrderAssignedTo]-(w:maintenance_WorkOrder)-[:maintenance_maintenance_WorkOrderOnStation]->(s:equipment_Station)-[:equipment_equipment_StationOnLine]->(l:equipment_ProductionLine)
RETURN t.name AS technician, l.line_id AS line, count(w) AS work_orders
GROUP BY technician, line
ORDER BY work_orders DESC
LIMIT 25

name: Floor issues by line and shift
description: Operator-logged floor issues by line, shift, and category.
gql:
MATCH (f:floorops_FloorIssue)-[:floorops_floorops_IssueAtStation]->(s:equipment_Station)-[:equipment_equipment_StationOnLine]->(l:equipment_ProductionLine), (f)-[:floorops_floorops_IssueDuringShift]->(sh:production_Shift)
RETURN l.line_id AS line, sh.shift AS shift, f.category AS category, count(f) AS issues
GROUP BY line, shift, category
ORDER BY issues DESC
LIMIT 20
